verdicts.argument: The short and long texts do not provide sufficient detail to meet VOB/A § 7 Abs. 1, so the scope remains unclear.
The position lacks stone size, joint width, and material class, which are required for a complete execution.
No gradation, binder content, or minimum thickness is specified for the asphalt base layer.
The mortar type, binding class, and reinforcement details are missing for the masonry.
Concrete class, reinforcement, dimensions, and installation method are not provided for the shaft.
Surface texture, binder content, and thickness are absent for the asphalt wearing course.
Screed thickness, reinforcement, and drying time are not indicated for the cement screed.
Material type, thickness, thermal conductivity, and performance class are missing for the frost protection layer.
The insulation thickness and thermal conductivity (WLS) are not specified for the floor insulation.
Plaster type, thickness, and applicable standards are not stated for the interior plaster.
The homogeneous area per DIN 18300 is not provided for the soil removal.
The water exposure class and DIN 18533 norm are missing for the ground-contact sealing.
